_meta.description: How far each cell of contradiction-matrix.csv has been checked. Cells not listed under cells have default_status.

statuses.verified: Checked against the primary source, Altshuller's 40 Principles (Shulyak and Rodman translation, 1997).
statuses.cross-checked: triz40.com and the pytriz copy agree, and the 1973 Altshuller Foundation table agrees on the principles. Not checked against the book.
statuses.disputed: The 1973 Altshuller Foundation table differs from the other two copies; see matrix-discrepancies.md. The CSV holds the triz40.com value until the book settles it.
statuses.unverified: Only one copy could be read.

sources.name: triz40.com online matrix
sources.role: Values in contradiction-matrix.csv. Source: TRIZ40 - www.triz40.com

sources.name: pytriz 0.4.0 (PyPI, MIT) resources/matrix_values.csv, identical to triz-mcp (npm, MIT) data/matrix.json
sources.role: Cross-check copy. Its origin is not documented, so it may share an ancestor with triz40.com.

sources.name: G.S. Altshuller Foundation, table of principles for technical contradictions
sources.role: Third copy with a documented origin: Altshuller, Algorithm of Invention (Moscow, 1973), Appendix 1. Transcribed twice; 29 content differences logged as disputed.

_meta.primary_source: Altshuller, G. 40 Principles: TRIZ Keys to Technical Innovation. Translated by L. Shulyak and S. Rodman. Technical Innovation Center, 1997. Not yet checked.
_meta.release_note: v1.0.0 ships with a three-copy cross-check (triz40.com, pytriz, Altshuller Foundation 1973 table). 29 cells are disputed. A cell-by-cell check against the book is still open; report a wrong cell with the 'Wrong matrix cell' issue form.
